subject.why: The radio matches the brief completely, featuring the turquoise-and-cream body, round dial, handle, and gold star detail.

category.why: The radio floats in three-quarter view without ground or scenery, set against centered concentric rings.

clean.why: No text, UI, frames, or characters are present.

framing.why: The radio is centrally framed with comfortable margins on all sides.

colour.why: Vibrant turquoise and cream contrast beautifully against a bright, warm pink background.

detail.why: Features are simplified and chunky with no noisy micro-textures or unnecessary props.

style.why: Smooth chunky 3D volumes with a soft satin sheen, closely matching the reference cards.
